meta.title: Sticky notes
meta.description: Numbered notes grouped by DSH workspace: click Sticky notes in the composer dock to write into the current workspace, or open the notes panel under Automation tasks in the sidebar. Bodies are plain Markdown under ~/.dsh/sticky-notes/ (override with DSH_STICKY_NOTES_DIR); the agent reads and writes them by number, hands a note over with status/owner, and posts to the workspace's shared board.
